1.bug_scenario: The bug scenario involves a BPMN diagram with an exclusive gateway that has two outgoing sequence flows. One of these flows is set as the default flow. When a Timer Intermediate Catch Event is added to the non-default flow, the 'default' attribute is removed from the gateway in the underlying model, even though the default flow is still visually rendered as default. This leads to a mismatch between the diagram's visual representation and its underlying data model.
